title: Before you let AI help
body: These questions keep you the one who learns. Run through them before and during any use of AI to study.
instruction: Tick each item once you have considered it.

_items.text: Have I asked who is doing the thinking on this task, me or the tool?
Am I using AI to understand something, or to avoid understanding it?
Could I explain this in my own words with the tool closed?
Is this a skill the task is meant to build in me?
Where does my use sit on the four levels of AI literacy?
